title: Parameter-Controlled Regime Transitions in Energy-Flow Cosmology: Cross-Sector Consistency Between Lensing and Background Observables
description: This paper analyzes how the sealed EFC lensing engine’s Σ_eff(z) crossover is controlled by model parameters and cross-validates robustness across power-spectrum choices. It finds that the kinetic stiffness scale K0 dominantly sets the redshift of the predicted sign-changing lensing coupling (z× ≈ 0.44), while amplitude parameters have minor impact, and documents qualitative µ < 1 agreement between the lensing and growth sectors. It pre-registers a falsification framework linking the non-monotonic lensing signature to growth and EG tests for upcoming Euclid DR1 and DESI DR2 data.

p1_zero_cross.description: Sealed EFC lensing prediction P1: a sign-changing crossover in the effective weak-lensing coupling at z ≈ 0.44.

p2_growth_seal.description: Sealed EFC growth prediction P2 for the linear growth observable at z = 0.7.

mu_damping_sign.description: Qualitative sector-level prediction: entropic damping of the Newtonian potential (both lensing and growth sectors yield \mu < 1).

horndeski_quadrant_constraint.description: Documented Horndeski-ensemble relation (Peirone et al. 2018), used here as a comparative structural constraint in the discrimination landscape.

key_results.main_finding: K0 is the dominant control on the Σ_eff(z) crossover redshift (Δz ≈ 0.87 over K0 ∈ [0.5, 4.0]), while joint ×50 amplitude rescaling changes the crossover by only Δz ≈ 0.11; the sign-changing prediction is robust to BBKS transfer-function choice (shift ≥ 0.06) and both sectors predict µ < 1.
datasets_used: Symbiose Framework Atlas (2026-04-21 snapshot) for comparative claims

sealed_predictions.statement: A non-monotonic, sign-changing Σ_eff(z) with a zero-crossing at z = 0.44 ± 0.03.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Euclid DR1 tomographic weak-lensing and slip reconstructions that measure the redshift dependence of Σ_eff(z) or equivalent lensing-modification parameterizations.
DESI DR2 redshift-space distortions and complementary Stage-IV growth probes at z ≈ 0.7.

sealed_predictions.statement: EG statistic prediction EG = 1.086 (pending kSZ-reconstructed estimators).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: kSZ-reconstructed EG estimators combining CMB, galaxy clustering, and lensing cross-correlations.

kill_criteria: KC1: Euclid DR1 (or equivalent Stage-IV lensing) finds Σ_eff(z) to be monotonic with no sign change in 0.2 < z < 1.0 at ≥ 3σ significance.
KC2: If a zero-crossing exists, its redshift differs from 0.44 by more than 5σ of the sealed tolerance (|z× − 0.44| > 0.15), after accounting for systematic and binning effects.
KC3: DESI DR2 (or comparable Stage-IV RSD) measures fσ8(z=0.7) inconsistent with 0.430 ± 0.02 at ≥ 3σ (e.g., fσ8 < 0.39 or > 0.47).
KC4: Joint lensing + growth analyses prefer µ(z ≈ 0.5) ≥ 1 at ≥ 3σ, contradicting the µ < 1 sign predicted by both EFC sectors.

KC5: Forward-model robustness failure: replacing the baseline power spectrum with reasonable transfer-function choices (e.g., BBKS/CAMB-like) flips the predicted sign of Σ_eff(z) or removes the crossover in otherwise admissible parameter ranges.
